RAJYA SABHA
————
List of Questions for WRITTEN  ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Wednesday, the July 31, 2002/Sravana 9, 1924 (Saka)
————
(Ministries:  Coal and Mines; Defence; Home Affairs; Non-Conventional
Energy Sources; Power; Rural Development; Textiles)
Total number of questions—112
330
WIN2\SESSION\2348RS.PM5 330
Fraud cases in Neyveli Lignite
Corporation Limited
1494. DR. AKHILESH DAS:
SHRI  AIMADUDDIN
AHMED KHAN
(DURRU):
Will the Minister of COAL AND
MINES be pleased to state:
(a) whether officers of Neyveli Lignite
Corporation Limited have been found
involved in fraud cases;
(b) if so, the nature of the fraud cases
detected; and
(c) the details of fraud cases registered
during 1999-2000, 2000-2001, 2001-2002
and the current year and action taken
thereon?
Limestone deposits in Gujarat
1495. DR. A.K. PATEL: Will the
Minister of COAL AND MINES be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the surveys and exploration
have established the availability of deposits
of various categories of lime stones in
Gujarat;
(b) if so, the district-wise and category-
wise location thereof;
(c) the protection and incentives
proposed to be provided by Government
for exploration and utilization of these
deposits;
(d) whether Government of Gujarat has
proposed any scheme in this regard; and
(e) if so, the details thereof and the
action being taken by the Government in
this regard?
Meeting of Indo-China Working
Group
1496. SHRI R.S. GAVAI: Will the
Minister of COAL AND MINES be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the meeting of the Indo-
China Working Group on Coal has been
held recently in China;
(b) if so, the details of the agenda
discussed during the meeting; and
(c) the decisions taken at the meeting?
Accident at Jayant Project of NCL
†1497. SHRI MUNAVVAR HASAN:
Will the Minister of COAL AND MINES
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the P&H
showel machine worth Rs. 8 crore and the
dumper No. 1525 worth Rs. 4 crore
perished completely as a result of accidents
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

331
WIN2\SESSION\2348RS.PM5 331
occured because of negligence of officials
in August 2001 in the Jayant project of the
Northern Coal Field Ltd.;
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
working hour of the each of the said
machines;
(c) the outcome of the committee which
went into the said accident;
(d) the root cause of the accident;
(e) the action taken against the Chief
General Manager, The General Manager
and the Dy. Chief General Manager; and
(f) whether Government propose to
have the C.B.I. episode?
State Ministers' meeting to discuss
report of Mineral Advisory Council
1498. SHRI K. RAMA MOHANA
RAO: Will the Minister of COAL AND
MINES be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that a meeting of
the State Ministers of Mining and Geology
was held in the first week of May, 2002 to
discuss the Report of the Mineral Advisory
Council;
(b) if so, the details of the meeting; and
(c) what is the outcome of the meeting?
Coal mines in Andhra Pradesh
1499. DR. DASARI NARAYANA
RAO: Will the Minister of COAL AND
MINES be pleased to state:
(a) the number of Coal mines in
operation in the State of Andhra Pradesh
at present, location-wise;
(b) whether it is a fact that some Coal
mines were closed in the recent past;
(c) if so, the details thereof for the last
five years, year-wise and reasons for
closure of each mine; and
(d) whether there is any possibility of
reopening these coal mines in the State?
Coal scam in BCCL
†1500. SHRI MOTILAL VORA: Will
the Minister of COAL AND MINES be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government's attention has
been drawn to the news-item published on
page number 7 of "The Rashtriya Sahara"
of 22nd May, 2002 under the caption
'Jharkhand Mein Huye Arabon Ke Ghotale
Ke Khilaf Andolan’;
(b) if so, whether it is a fact that a scam
of about Rs. 9500 crores has taken place
in the supply of unsuitable coal and the
procurement of items in BCCL, Dhanbad;
(c) if so, Government's reaction thereto;
(d) whether Government propose to
punish the guilty persons;
(e) if so, the details thereof; and
(f) if not, the reasons therefor?
Action plan to use available mineral
reserve
1501. DR. DASARI NARAYANA
RAO: Will the Minister of COAL AND
MINES be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have any
action plan to make best use of available
mineral reserves in Andhra Pradesh and
rest of the country; and
(b) if so, the details thereof?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

Officers accused in Tehalka Tapes were
found guilty in the inquiry conducted by
Army Court;
(b) if so, names of these officers
alongwith the charges proved against them;
